metabr Developer Guide Overview & Architecture

Package Purpose & Ecosystem

metabr (v0.2.4) is an R package within the foundr / systems genetics ecosystem providing specialized tools for metabolomics data ingestion, mass spectrometry peak-area quality control (QC) batch correction, normalization, and curation discrepancy analysis.

  • Author: Brian S. Yandell (brian.yandell@wisc.edu)
  • License: GPL-3
  • Minimum R Version: ≥3.5.0\ge 3.5.0

Systems Genetics Data Ingestion Pipeline 

flowchart TD
    subgraph input [Raw Mass Spectrometry Input]
        csvFile["El-MAVEN / LC-MS CSV File"]

    end

    subgraph metabrEngine [metabr Data Ingestion & QC Engine]
        readRaw["read_raw_metab() / read_batch_metab()"]
        qcSteps["qc_steps() Core Driver"]
        calcCF["calc_cf() Plate QC Averaging"]
        replaceCF["replace_missing_ave_cf() Fallbacks"]
        correctCF["correct_raw_cf() Intensity Scaling"]
        norm["normalize() log2 Mean-Centering"]

        readRaw --> qcSteps
        qcSteps --> calcCF
        calcCF --> replaceCF
        replaceCF --> correctCF
        correctCF --> norm
    end

    subgraph downstream [Ecosystem Integration]
        writeMetab["write_metab() Export Wide Data"]
        handAuto["hand_auto() Curation Comparison"]
        foundrHarm["foundrHarmony Ingestion"]
        foundrCore["foundr Variance Partitioning"]

        norm --> writeMetab
        norm --> handAuto
        writeMetab --> foundrHarm
        foundrHarm --> foundrCore
    end

Developer Quick Start

Local Development Commands

To inspect, update, or test metabr locally:

# 1. Load local development files
devtools::load_all()

# 2. Generate roxygen documentation & NAMESPACE
devtools::document()

# 3. Build pkgdown documentation site locally
pkgdown::build_site(install = FALSE)

# 4. Run package verification
devtools::check(cran = FALSE, vignettes = FALSE)

Batch Organization & Pipeline Workflows

Metabolomics data drops are organized by timestamped subdirectories under data/"QC Batch Correction" (20231127, 20251112, 20261020), as documented in datasets.Rmd.

End-to-end processing is automated through QC_Automation.Rmd, parameterized by batch_date:

# Execute pipeline for default batch (20261020)
rmarkdown::render("QC_Automation.Rmd")

# Or render an earlier cohort
rmarkdown::render("QC_Automation.Rmd", params = list(batch_date = "20251112"))

Developer Guide Navigation

This Developer Guide is organized into the following detailed sub-articles:

  1. Developer Guide Overview & Architecture: Package purpose, ecosystem architecture, end-to-end processing flowchart, and quick start instructions.
  2. QC Pipeline & Correction Methodology: Mathematical specifications for QC correction factors, compound-wise median retention time (medRt) handling, missing value imputation, and hand_auto curation diagnostics.
  3. Data Ingestion & IO Format Specifications: Detailed schemas for raw mass spectrometry spreadsheets, minute time-course files, and long-format tidy data frame representations.
  4. CI/CD & Site Deployment Walkthrough: Specifications for pkgdown site building, GitHub Actions deployment workflow, and repository configuration.
  5. Package Refactoring & Data Reorganization: Context and timeline for the 2026 data reorganization, QC pipeline unification, and recipe for ingesting future data drops.
  6. QC Datasets & Directory Organization: Details on timestamped data drops under data/"QC Batch Correction", protocol SOPs, and MS OneDrive links.
